outcome: Feasibility of discharge within 23 hours following TLH
cohort: 128 women undergoing TLH for benign indications or early-stage cervical/endometrial cancer
finding: Hospital discharge within 23 hours of TLH appears to be safe, feasible, and acceptable to patients when a standardized, multidisciplinary care protocol is used.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean sections were associated with a greater likelihood of stay beyond 23 hours (P<0.05).
